product_hero_content.product_hero_content_title: What is the Greece Golden Visa?

product_hero_content_text.product_hero_content_text_item: The Greece Golden Visa is a residence permit program established by the Greek government.
Open to non-EU investors and their families who invest in Greek real estate.
Three generations of your family can live in Greece and travel across the 29 countries of the Schengen Area.

product_hero_content_text_subs.product_hero_content_text_sub_item: The €250,000 threshold applies to the change of use category, where commercial property is converted to residential use; taxes and fees are not included.

product_benefits_item_bullets.product_benefits_item_bullet_text: Live, invest, run a business, and study freely in Greece.

product_benefits_items.product_benefits_item_title: Freedom of travel across the Schengen Area

product_benefits_item_bullets.product_benefits_item_bullet_text: Travel to the 29 Schengen Area countries under the short-stay rule of 90 days in any 180-day period.

product_benefits_items.product_benefits_item_title: Access to education on the same terms as Greek nationals

product_benefits_item_bullets.product_benefits_item_bullet_text: Your children study free of charge at Greek public schools, from primary school through public university.

product_benefits_items.product_benefits_item_title: From the Greece Golden Visa to Greek citizenship

product_benefits_item_bullets.product_benefits_item_bullet_text: Once you have completed the required period of lawful residence and met the residence, language, and integration conditions set by Greek law, you may become eligible to apply for citizenship.
Visa-free or eVisa access to more than 180 destinations, including the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, and countries across Europe.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What is the Greece Golden Visa, and how does it differ from permanent residence?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The Golden Visa is Greece's long-term residence permit for investors.

It carries much the same day-to-day rights as permanent residence: you and your family can live in Greece, open a business, and send your children to school there (salaried employment is not permitted).
The permit is valid for 5 years and is renewable in 5-year terms as long as you continue to meet the conditions.
It can also be a first step toward Greek citizenship, provided you meet the residence, language, and integration conditions set by Greek law.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Does the Greece Golden Visa allow free movement across the Schengen Area and the EU?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Short-term travel within the Schengen Area — not the right to live or work across the EU
The Golden Visa allows travel within the Schengen Area under the short-stay rule of 90 days in any 180-day period.
Travel to EU countries outside the Schengen Area still requires a visitor visa under each country's own rules.
The right to live, work, and study in any EU country arises only once you hold Greek citizenship.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What is the difference between the Schengen Area and the EU?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The Schengen Area is not the same thing as the EU

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The European Union (EU): an intergovernmental organization of 27 countries.
The Schengen Area: a zone that allows free movement between its member countries.
Some EU countries are outside the Schengen Area, and some Schengen countries are outside the EU.
Greece is a member of both the Schengen Area and the EU.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Can my children study in Greece for free?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Children study free of charge at Greek public schools.
From primary school through postgraduate study.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What are the risks of a Greece Golden Visa investment?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: A Golden Visa investment carries 2 main risks.

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Choosing a project or developer without a solid track record, or a project that does not qualify.
Investment funds that are not lawfully sourced, which leads to the application being denied.

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_note: IMM Group carries out detailed due diligence on your file before any contract is signed, which helps reduce source-of-funds risk.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Is proving source of funds for the Greece Golden Visa complicated?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Simpler than the United States, Australia, or Canada

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: You only need to document your lawful source of funds at a basic level
For example, for a property sale you will need to show the year of purchase and the value at that time

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_note: Every family documents its funds differently — contact IMM Group for advice on your own situation.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: How long must I hold the real estate before I can sell it?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Only after 7 years of residence in Greece on the Golden Visa.
If you apply for Greek citizenship, the real estate may then be sold.
If you keep the Golden Visa instead, the real estate investment must be maintained.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: How long is the Greece Golden Visa valid, and how is it renewed?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: A 5-year permit, renewable every 5 years

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Renewal conditions

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: You still own the real estate
A clean criminal record
After 7 years: you may apply for Greek citizenship if you meet the residence and language conditions.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: How do dependents renew their residence permits?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Main applicant and spouse: renewal works the same way, with no limit on the number of renewals, as long as you still own the real estate and your criminal record remains clean.
Dependent children: renewal is possible only up to age 24

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Three options once a child turns 24:

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The child applies for Greek citizenship, if eligible, to keep the right of residence.
Under the new rules, a child under 18 is named as the main applicant.
The real estate is transferred to the child, who can then keep renewing — though this route involves more time and cost.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: How many days a year do I have to spend in Greece?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: There is no continuous residence requirement to maintain the Golden Visa.

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: You do not need to live in Greece continuously to hold and renew the Golden Visa.
If you plan to apply for Greek citizenship later, you will need to meet the residence and integration conditions set by Greek law.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What are the requirements to move from the Greece Golden Visa to citizenship?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Five conditions for Greek citizenship:

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: 7 years of physical residence in Greece — at least 183 days a year
A source of income in Greece
Greek language ability at B1 level, plus a pass in the citizenship exam on history, culture, and institutions
Proof of integration into Greek society
No criminal record in Greece or abroad

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Separate conditions for children:

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Nine years of schooling in Greece (primary and secondary), or
Six years of schooling in Greece (secondary) before the age of 18

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What are the benefits of holding Greek citizenship?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Full EU citizenship rights.
Freedom to live, work, and study in any EU country.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Is there an age limit for Greece Golden Visa applicants?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: No age limit for applicants

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: No upper age limit
Under the new rules, a child under 18 may be the main applicant

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: When a child is the main applicant

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The parents authorize a lawyer to purchase the real estate
The parents join the application as dependents

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Does the Greece Golden Visa require a degree or management experience?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: No education or experience requirement.
No degree or management experience is required.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Which family members can be included in the application?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Three groups of family members can be included in the application

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Your legal spouse
Children, including adopted children, up to age 21
The parents of both spouses

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Are adopted children and stepchildren eligible?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Adopted children and stepchildren are eligible
General conditions

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Unmarried and under 21

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Adopted child

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: A legal adoption certificate is required.

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Stepchild

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: A legal certificate plus a notarized letter of consent from the spouse.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What is the maximum age for a child to be included in the application?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Children up to age 21

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Children up to age 21 can be included in the same application.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Can my parents be included in the application?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Parents can be included in the application

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The parents of both spouses can be included in the same application.
